claims.claim_ar: الفعل يَتَعَدَّى يجوز أن يتعدى إلى مفعولين
claims.claim_en: The verb يَتَعَدَّى (yata'adda) may take two objects (i.e., can govern up to two maf'oolāt).
حُدُودَهُ (hudoodahu) functions as (one of) the direct object(s) (maf'ool bihi) governed by the verb يَتَعَدَّى in this clause.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source gives the general rule that يَتَعَدَّى can take two objects, but it does not provide an explicit parsing of this specific occurrence in S.4:A14; application to this ayah is therefore an inference from the rule.

warnings: The provided al-Tibyan chunk states the general rule that يَتَعَدَّى can take two objects (يَتَعَدَّى إِلَى مَفْعُولَيْنِ) but does not explicitly analyze Sura 4:14. The identification of حدوده as a مفعول به here is inferred from that general rule and should be reviewed against sources that treat this specific verse.
